title.narrative: UNDP-GNQ_ Impulso Profesional para jovenes guineanos

description.narrative: The complexity and multidimensional nature of youth unemployment in Equatorial Guinea has highlighted the need to reinforce collective responsibility among the actors accountable for improving employability and access to a first job. Young people, especially young women and people with disabilities, must lead productive opportunities, acting as agents of change and transformation in an economy oriented towards sustainable diversification. Therefore, the Professional Impulse Programme will develop four interventions that will place young people of working age in Equatorial Guinea as promoters of transformative change, reinforcing the initial state of unemployment, through: i. The collection and analysis of disaggregated data on the real needs of young people in terms of employment;ii. The design and implementation of non-formal education programmes based on skills development;iii. The allocation of traineeship placements through the formalisation of partnerships with the private sector;iv. The development of innovative youth-led solutions, in which technology is positioned as a key enabler for accessing a first job.
